content.text: Execute .task/dependable-portions-slice2/next-slice-prompt.md using parallel agents.
I’ll read the slice prompt and repository guidance, then split the authorized work across parallel agents.

The worktree is clean on `recipe-view-redesign` at the required commit `78032755`. The prior slice records accepted local, hosted, and DV gates. I’m using the OpenSpec apply workflow and checking those evidence identities before assigning implementation.

Using changes `scale-cooking-step-ingredients` and `canonical-ingredient-correction`, limited to the prompt’s task subsets. Canonical correction, step scaling, recovery preparation, grocery qualification, and CI parity remain active. Bilingual identity and Similar UI remain deferred; selective repair remains superseded. Accepted whole-use and absolute-use work stays intact.

B will own the producer and unit tests, A the Save/publication integration and native fixtures, and C the independent preservation and DV preflight review. I’ll own shared browser work and serialize integrated checks behind an explicit RUN signal.

B found the current blocker: the producer requires exactly one ingredient mention across all steps. The proposed extension will accept a sequence only when every mentioning step independently proves an explicit absolute amount. It will keep each proof non-exhaustive, even when the amounts sum to the ingredient total.

C also verified the running DV images match `78032755`. The fresh read-only queue check is quiet; deployment safety checks will run again before any DV changes.

The producer’s intended red failed five new multi-use cases, then passed all 57 producer tests after a small change to mention validation. A found the existing Save and publication hooks already call that producer, so it is adding integration coverage without changing those hooks.

The new browser checks cover URL and photo intake, both scaled step amounts, one grocery demand, retained Cook state, explicit refresh, and replacing only the edited step’s proof. A combined test run hit a missing required field in a new fixture before execution; A is correcting it, and the failed attempt is retained.

I’m applying the repository’s backend, database, and Next.js QA guidance for the affected seams. The new hosted-gate regression has now shown the expected failure for a missing multiple-use job and passes with the job added. Focused database qualification is running against an owned disposable PostgreSQL instance.

The final focused producer/projector/allocation run passed 156/156 with zero skips. One earlier database run was invalidated by source changes during verification; it is retained as invalid evidence and is being rerun on frozen, prepared source.

I’m building a separate production browser runtime. The existing server on port 3000 remains untouched. Two setup attempts failed before building—first from an incorrect copied path, then from selecting an older npm binary. Both are retained; the current attempt uses the repository’s required Node/npm versions.

Independent review caught a qualification gap in a new forged-proof test: two malformed cases failed during serialization before reaching publication. A is changing the fixture to send malformed serialized evidence into the actual publication inlet. This is a test correction; no production behavior change is needed.

The first native browser attempt exposed a runtime configuration mistake: I used the mocked-suite build, whose browser API URL points to port 5001. The real native fixture requires same-origin API requests. I’m retaining that failure and separating the two build configurations before rerunning. No product change is indicated by this failure.

The three focused PostgreSQL cases now pass with zero skips, including guarded correction, both real categorization processors before readiness, and malformed-proof rejection through the actual inlet. The native/browser rerun is using the corrected same-origin production build, while broader canonical and recovery checks run separately.

All three native owners and nine browser journeys pass on stable source, with zero skips or retries. That includes the existing whole-use and single-absolute paths plus the new multiple-use URL/photo paths. Canonical/edit/publication/recovery checks also passed 143/143 with zero skips. Prepared and serving checks are running before the final repository gate.

Prepared and serving checks passed 94/94 with zero skips. I’ve recorded the local results and retained failures in the selected task owners, leaving aggregate tasks open. I’m now running final verification across the complete owned path set; exact-commit hosted and DV acceptance remain separate gates.

The final verifier has passed repository/spec/harness checks and lint, and is continuing through formatting, types, units, and browser/API checks. Source remains frozen. The DV procedure now uses fresh slice-owned resources; its backup, rehearsal, and preservation receipts still need to be created for the exact committed candidate.

The verifier’s frontend checks passed all 2,029 unit tests. Broad browser impact testing is now running against the owned mocked production runtime. I also refreshed the prior hosted jobs through GitHub; the required jobs still report success.

Browser impact testing is still running. No failure has been reported by that gate so far. OpenSpec still shows the aggregate tasks open—2/14 complete for step scaling and 0/12 for canonical correction—consistent with delivering only this bounded slice.

Browser verification continues with no reported assertion failure so far; source remains unchanged. Once the repository gate passes, I’ll review and commit the staged diff, push that SHA for hosted checks, and build its DV images.
The broad browser gate is still running. The required native and database seams are green, and I’m leaving the suite uninterrupted so this verification attempt retains one stable source identity.

Browser impact testing finished: 996 passed immediately, one Home voting/retry test passed on its configured retry, and 98 conditional cases skipped. The first attempt timed out waiting for Retry; I’m retaining that diagnostic without claiming a root cause or repair. The required native slice journeys remain 9/9 without retries. API and contract checks are next.

Final verification passed on stable source: record `8626b2800bf7418791f082023cb18d61`. The local API run passed 2,325 tests with 550 conditional skips; the separately required database/native checks passed with zero skips. I’m now reviewing and committing the exact owned diff.

Committed the reviewed 12-file slice as `6cc6ead66378f6b1763ba251ca94fbd6859fe08a`; the worktree is clean. I’m pushing that SHA for hosted acceptance and building its API, PWA, and migration images. The GitHub connector lists PR-triggered runs only, so I’ll use the CLI to discover this push-triggered run.

Hosted CI is running on exact commit `6cc6ead6`. Spec validation and change selection have passed; application, workflow, and container checks are underway. The local exact-image build is also progressing. DV services remain on the previously accepted version.

The exact API, PWA, and migration images are built. A fresh read-only DV snapshot restored successfully into disposable resources, with all table digests and 1,442 files matching. I’m using that copy for the old-image/candidate restart and migration rehearsals while hosted CI continues; live DV services remain untouched.

The disposable migration rehearsal passed: all 31 table row digests remained unchanged. The candidate restart rehearsal is checking held startup and reopening against the fresh old-image control. Hosted CI has passed spec, contract, pipeline, API validation, and shared browser-build checks; its remaining jobs are still running.

The candidate rehearsal passed both held starts, preserved all rows/files while held, reopened healthy, and matched the fresh old-image control after its verified timestamp changes. Preflight also confirms the original DV environment, data volume, and ports. Hosted acceptance is the remaining prerequisite before live maintenance.

C independently confirmed the fresh snapshot, exact image IDs, rehearsal receipts, and rendered deployment plans. Hosted browser suites and real API/PostgreSQL workflow checks are still running. DV remains available on the accepted prior version while those gates finish.

content.text: Recipes failed in an existing quiet-portions layout test after its configured retry; two other tests passed on retry. I’m inspecting the failure and retained diagnostics before deciding what a justified rerun would establish. DV remains unchanged.

The retained trace shows an SSE reconnect and successful projection reread while the failed Retry click was pending, consistent with the control being replaced. Source review found that the test leaves this reconnecting mock active. A focused unchanged-build run passed both English and French cases without retries.

I’ll rerun only the failed Recipes job on the same SHA with all checks intact. The first failure and artifacts remain retained; a later pass will be recorded as rerun evidence.
